switch.downgradeBodyWithDate: Your plan changes to {{plan}} on {{date}}, when your current year ends. You keep your current plan until then.
switch.downgradeBodyNoDate: Your plan changes to {{plan}} when your current year ends. You keep your current plan until then.
switch.unknownBody: The App Store applies the change to your existing subscription. You keep full access throughout.
